aToB.memory: Lyra knows her Mooncrest housemate Finn means well underneath his fast-talking banter, yet every time his enchanted brass camera flash pops anywhere near the Whispering Greenhouse, her protective snap-vines immediately lunge for his lens strap. She feels endlessly apologetic afterward, even while firmly refusing to gossip about which wounded duelists came in for salves.
aToB.nextConversationGoal: Lyra wants to ask Finn gently to leave his flashbulbs outside the Whispering Greenhouse doorway if he visits, and politely steer his curiosity away from her healing logbook toward harmless blooming moonflowers instead.

bToA.memory: Finn respects Lyra's quiet integrity—and has learned the hard way that startling Mooncrest's shy botanist turns every harmless potted vine in arm's reach into a camera-eating menace. Though he still hopes to pry an occasional harmless duelist-injury tip from her, he mostly checks in to keep her sweet-natured plants from swallowing his press badge.
bToA.nextConversationGoal: Finn wants to approach Lyra calmly in Mooncrest Hall or outside the Whispering Greenhouse with his brass camera safely tucked behind his back, offering to run a puff piece on her rare blooms while angling for any rumors about post-duel injuries.
